description: Back up an OpenVox primary server into one archive under destination: the selected items' files as they are on the host, a manifest of the host (versions, gems, deployed code, CA serial, OpenVoxDB schema) and the topology the server sees, with checksums of every file. Returns the archive path and size

destination.description: Directory for the archive, created 0700 if missing. Default /var/backups/openvox

ca.description: Include the CA directory, the server's own certificate and key, and OpenVoxDB's copy of them. Default true

config.description: Include the rest of /etc/puppetlabs (without code/) and the services' environment files. Default true

code.description: Include each environment's .r10k-deploy.json and hiera.yaml, the record of what r10k deployed, and /etc/puppetlabs/r10k. Default true

include_code_tree.description: With code, take /etc/puppetlabs/code itself. Default false

extra_paths.description: Comma-separated absolute paths outside /etc/puppetlabs to include, such as the r10k deploy key. Each must exist

stop_services.description: Stop puppetserver and puppetdb while the files are copied, and start them again afterwards. Default false

age_recipient.description: An age public key; the archive is encrypted to it and named .tar.gz.age. age must be installed

ovadm_version.description: Recorded in the manifest; the plan passes its own version
